content.title: About
content.content: Quaker Chewy Granola Bar is a soft, chewy snack made from whole grains, honey, and dried fruit, produced by Quaker Oats. It is designed for a quick on‑the‑go bite and contains a blend of oats, sunflower seeds, raisins, and nuts, with a modest amount of sugar and salt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Quaker Chewy bars are available in several flavors, such as chocolate, honey‑nut, and cranberry‑orange.
The product is marketed as an "energy snack" and is often promoted to athletes and active‑lifestyle consumers.
Each bar weighs about 35 g and provides roughly 150 kcal.
Quaker Oats is one of the oldest cereal brands in the United States, founded in 1901.
Bars contain no artificial colors, though some flavors may include monosodium glutamate.

items.title: Source of whole grains
items.content: Oats supply slow‑releasing carbohydrates that help maintain steady energy levels and promote satiety.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and can aid in blood‑sugar regulation.

items.title: B‑vitamin content
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, and B6 are involved in carbohydrate metabolism and nervous‑system function.

items.title: Small amount of iron
items.content: Iron is essential for oxygen transport in the blood, especially important during physical activity.

items.title: Balanced energy profile
items.content: The mix of carbs and a modest amount of fat provides a quick energy boost without a sharp glucose spike.

items.title: Allergy to nuts or gluten
items.content: Bars may contain nuts, soy, and wheat, posing a risk for individuals with those allergies.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although moderate, the sugar may be a concern for people monitoring blood glucose.

items.title: Caloric density if over‑consumed
items.content: Eating multiple bars daily can lead to excess calorie intake.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Salt is added for flavor; those with hypertension should consider the amount.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar is convenient to eat straight from the package as a quick snack between meals, can be chopped into yogurt or oatmeal, or used as an energy bite before workouts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, consume within 5–7 days to retain the bar’s chewy texture.
